description: Presidential Secretariat - Establishment of a Presidential Task Force for Rebuilding Sri Lanka.
categorisation: This gazette establishes a Presidential Task Force and lists specific individuals (e.g., Hon. Harini Amarasuriya, Hon. H. M. Vijitha Herath) by name and title. Crucially, it also provides detailed portfolio responsibilities for each appointed minister (e.g., "Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism"). The content contains both the "who" (named government personnel) and the "what" (their detailed ministerial portfolios and the specific tasks/responsibilities of the Task Force), meeting the criteria for a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3). Government-related classifications take precedence, and the presence of both elements mandates Type 3.
